brief_description: Next-generation multimodal video model supporting text, image, video, and audio references with 768P and 2K output.
detailed_description:
# MiniMax-H3 API Usage Guide

## Overview

MiniMax-H3 generates videos from text prompts and optional image, video, or audio references. It supports text-to-video, first/last-frame image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation.

## Submit a Request

```json
{
  "model": "MiniMax-H3",
  "payload": {
    "prompt": "A cinematic view of a spacecraft launching at sunset",
    "resolution": "2K",
    "duration": 5,
    "ratio": "16:9"
  }
}
```

## Supported Inputs

- `prompt`: required text prompt, up to 7000 characters.
- `first_frame_image` and `last_frame_image`: frame image URLs.
- `reference_images`: up to 9 reference images.
- `reference_videos`: up to 3 reference videos.
- `reference_audios`: up to 3 reference audio files; audio cannot be used alone.

Frame-based inputs and reference-media inputs cannot be mixed in the same request. MiniMax performs final validation.

## Output

Completed requests return a permanent video URL and generated thumbnail in the request outcome.
pricing_details: Output pricing: 768P costs $0.08 per second; 2K costs $0.13 per second.

parameters.name: first_frame_image
parameters.description: Image used as the first frame. Cannot be combined with reference media.

parameters.name: last_frame_image
parameters.description: Image used as the final frame. Cannot be combined with reference media.

parameters.name: reference_images
parameters.description: Images used to guide reference-to-video generation. Maximum 9 images.

parameters.name: reference_videos
parameters.description: Videos used to guide generation. Maximum 3 videos with a combined duration of at most 15 seconds.

parameters.name: reference_audios
parameters.description: Audio references used with at least one reference image or video. Maximum 3 audio files.

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.description: Text-to-video requires a concrete ratio. Image-to-video uses adaptive regardless of the supplied value.
